Are you excited for the Spartan Games?
Who are you most interested in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa! Easy, girl!

nodes.text: That's it. Calm down. Good horse.

nodes.text: Impressive...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Back off, buddy. The lady's not interested.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard.
Howard turns to Chad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, get off our field!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh, I don't think so. Not only are we `not` getting off of `our` field, but once we've won the Spartan Games, there won't even be a football field.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I don't think so. Not only are we [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] getting off of [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] field, but once we've won the Spartan Games, there won't even be a football field.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The first thing we'll do is remove the goal posts. Then get rid of those ridiculous painted lines.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh really? Whoever wins the Spartan Games controls $100,000... And that amount of money basically guarantees that we'll be able to do whatever we want!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: First we'll change the name, then the policies...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Then the cheerleading uniforms...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: How about bikinis for everyone?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm actually okay with that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Please don't make that the policy for `everyone` on the team.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please don't make that the policy for [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] on the team.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Then we'll gold-plate the lockers and get a gourmet chef to cook the meals. All other clubs will be cut to afford us our extravagant lifestyle!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And finally, even the name... I hope you're all ready to start attending `New` Spartan Academy!
nodes.text_bbcode: And finally, even the name... I hope you're all ready to start attending [color=#e23b3b][i]New[/i][/color] Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `NO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I tried to be nice, but Justin is right!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what's gotten into you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Centerscore is the first place that I've ever really felt at home. Even if I didn't always get along with everyone... I'm `not` letting anyone ruin it! Even if it means entering the Spartan Games and winning them myself!
nodes.text_bbcode: Centerscore is the first place that I've ever really felt at home. Even if I didn't always get along with everyone... I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] letting anyone ruin it! Even if it means entering the Spartan Games and winning them myself!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It doesn't matter how many people join... We've been preparing for this for years! You don't even know the rules! None of you have a chance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll just have to wait and see.
Wow! Looks like $ZOE's found her fighting spirit! You really helped her see that she needs to stand up to the Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And there's no one at this loser school to stop us!
Oh no! Things are looking bleak. If $ZOE's day had been a little different, maybe she'd be ready to step up...
But for now, let's leave $ZOE and see how Sam is doing.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You'd rather doom all of humanity to extinction? Cruelty, thy name is cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, sleazeball, thy name is Mark!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: That's messed up!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure I'll see you in my dreams tonight. Meet you there, sweetheart.
Mark winks at her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uggghhh.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Speechless, huh? Don't worry, I have that effect on girls. I'll pick you up at eight. Wear something nice.
$ZOE trips and crashes into a horse's side!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeek!
The horse rears and kicks the air, hitting Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: This reminds me of the good old days when feudal lords would ride by on horseback to frighten their peasants.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it with you guys and historical inaccuracies?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, they've been really difficult so far.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That just means we should try harder! I know that if we can get to know them, they'll turn out to be just the same as us!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Your optimism is one of the things I like best about you, $ZOE... But in this case, I think you're wrong.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What about you, Howard? Are you up for defending Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think so, Justin. Between babysitting the twins and football, I don't really have time for another extracurricular activity.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just think about it, okay? We need people to step up!
Justin goes off to hand out another flyer. $ZOE looks down at the paper in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess...
A few minutes later $ZOE walks onto the field, where the football players are running drills and the cheerleaders are practicing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where's my fruity drink? I said I wanted a fruity drink! We can't start practice until I have my fruity drink!
Maria runs up carrying an orange drink with a tiny umbrella in it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's better. Now, let's start with the inverted pyramid while we spell out my name...
Suddenly, a group of Spartan guys ride by on horseback! The cheerleaders dive out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Tally ho!
The football players are driven to the sidelines!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on? We're supposed to have the football field today!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: That was a rule `your` school came up with. Spartans don't respect Centerscore authority.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was a rule [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] school came up with. Spartans don't respect Centerscore authority.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: No taxation without representation!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That is `not` what that means.
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] what that means.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: In any case, seeing as how `we've` got the horses, I think on this field, `we` make the rules!
nodes.text_bbcode: In any case, seeing as how [color=#e23b3b][i]we've[/i][/color] got the horses, I think on this field, [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] make the rules!

nodes.text: Chad pulls on the reins, and his horse whinnies and rears! The other horses start kicking!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! I need to calm these horses down... Fast!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The marketing? I made these posters myself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're just... A little bleak. I mean, is this really the message you want to be sending?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, the Spartan Games aren't going to be all rainbows and kittens and cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is going to be a fight to the bitter end against evil!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to insult your flyer. It's just... You're making the Spartans into the enemy.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They `are` the enemy!
nodes.text_bbcode: They [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] the enemy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Justin, they're students here... Just like you and me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: After everything we've been through... We don't need more conflict and competition! We need to start getting along!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Put yourself in the Spartans' shoes. They lost their school! And it was a boarding school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For a lot of them, that was their home! Now they're at a new school. They're outnumbered. We should be trying to make them feel welcome, not trying to beat them at their own game.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We have experience! We've been in the Spartan Games before.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I don't think there's a Centerscore guy here that can beat any of us Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Unless you think `you're` man enough to do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you think [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] man enough to do it!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ha ha! That's great, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: No girl has ever won that sacred Spartan `crown!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No girl has ever won that sacred Spartan [color=#e23b3b][i]crown![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You guys are really pissing me off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course a girl hasn't won! Spartan was an `all-boys` school and...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course a girl hasn't won! Spartan was an [color=#3b78e2][i]all-boys[/i][/color] school and...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Wait, did you say crown?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! The winner of the games always dons the crown passed down from generation to generation of Spartan men!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like... A Homecoming crown?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! Nothing like that! This crown is cool and manly and not-at-all dainty...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And `I'm` gonna be the one to wear it!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] gonna be the one to wear it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I bet they wouldn't be so cocky if they had some real competition. I should enter myself!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not only would it feel pretty satisfying to kick the pants off these Spartan boys, but this is my second chance to get a crown!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Could I do this? Could I really do this?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Just give up, already! You can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, sorry to disappoint you guys, but you're going to have to get used to seeing that manly Spartan crown on a Centerscore girl!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because `I'm` joining the Spartan Games!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] joining the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Do what you want.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But `this` isn't over.
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] isn't over.

nodes.text: The boys stalk away.
$ZOE turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You think us girls can win?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, the way I see it, you're going to need to be strong, sneaky, and smart to win at the games...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And girls are the strongest, sneakiest, smartest people I know!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We definitely have an opportunity...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And this is my chance to win that crown!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we'll just see what happens when it happens!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Sure thing.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Smell you later!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm glad to see the quality of my companions only continues to improve...
The boys walk off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened? I thought for sure you were going to challenge them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's the point? Anytime I try out for a crown, things end up going wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh Sam... But you could still join the games. You could chance it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, thanks, $ZOE. I'm out.
Sam goes back to eating her lunch, disinterested.
That's enough about Sam... Now let's see what Colt is up to!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You noticed?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I lift weights.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh... That's exactly what I `didn't` want to say...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... That's exactly what I [color=#3b78e2][i]didn't[/i][/color] want to say...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Thanks for the flattery, but...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We have something else you pathetic Centerscorians don't have!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because it's doing a great job of making me want to clear out of your way.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! We have something else! Something better!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Something great!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Geez, really? Are you even `trying` to insult him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, really? Are you even [color=#e23b3b][i]trying[/i][/color] to insult him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Thanks for the flattery, but...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We have something else you pathetic Centerscorians don't have!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your brain?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No, you're wrong! When Spartan wins all that money for the school...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We'll be in charge of everything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's no guarantee you'll win.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Of course we will.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Because we have one thing on our side...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that, your...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hard to disagree with that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't just walk all over the sports teams.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, nothing against you ladies, but I definitely prefer watching TV to a lot of other things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, bad example.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I `meant` was...
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#3b78e2][i]meant[/i][/color] was...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't just walk all over the sports teams.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha ha! That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Everyone knows boys sports are more popular than girls sports.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam, but unfortunately, there are studies to support that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Thanks,` Poindexter.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thanks,[/i][/color] Poindexter.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Just stating a truth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I `meant` was...
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#3b78e2][i]meant[/i][/color] was...

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But back to my point...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't make our sports uniforms more flimsy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No one will take us seriously!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No one does that anyway!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Come on, sports isn't really a 'girl' thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah. Girls aren't built for stuff like that. They're just not as strong.

nodes.speaker: Chad

nodes.speaker: Chad

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: His mom exists. I've met her.

nodes.speaker: Chad

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: I'm surprised you couldn't tell by his designer sweater and gold loafers...

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Carson

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, nothing at all!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No surprise there, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, I don't know what it is.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's the tournament where Spartan and Centerscore guys are going to battle it out for a $100,000 grand prize!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? We're participating in that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aren't any of you excited?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I heard Justin was tricked into making us participate. I don't want to join in what appears to be nothing more than a petty male ritual.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It sounds dumb.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's `not` dumb. Come on, watching a bunch of rugged guys in the forest, battling it out while we sit on the sidelines?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] dumb. Come on, watching a bunch of rugged guys in the forest, battling it out while we sit on the sidelines?

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And... We're back to this.
At that moment, $ZOE approaches the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mind if I sit?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, no?
Sam shoots a glare at Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I mean... It's okay... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's up, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's the Spartan boys... I keep hearing about what they're going to do to the school when they win the Spartan Games.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's upsetting!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What are they going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of things...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like turning the cheerleading outfits into skimpy bathing suits!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's not just the cheerleading team that will be affected. The entire school will! Including the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're making the cheerleaders perform in swim suits... Just imagine what they'll have the swim team wearing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ew.` You've got to be kidding me if I'm going to let a bunch of gross, sketchy guys tell me what to wear!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ew.[/i][/color] You've got to be kidding me if I'm going to let a bunch of gross, sketchy guys tell me what to wear!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, watch what you're saying!
The passing Spartan boys come over.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Those gross sketchy guys you're talking about happen to be us!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Again, Chad, do you think before talking?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You two are the ones who came up with stupid outfits for the girls' sports teams?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Whoa, those ideas belong to this clever guy.
Sensing danger, Carson points at Chad and backs away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't change our swim team uniforms.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait, wait, hold up... Girls' sports teams are real? They're not just ridiculous things you made up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Women's sports are a real thing! Unlike your...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The guys I've dated... All they ever wanted to do was talk about sports or tell me about how they almost crashed their motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah... `Talking` about motorcycles is not as fun as `riding` on motorcycles.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#3b78e2][i]Talking[/i][/color] about motorcycles is not as fun as [color=#3b78e2][i]riding[/i][/color] on motorcycles.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone that really understands me this time around would be great.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, you already dated Matteo? Who's hotter than him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hmm... Good point.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Really? You don't really strike me as the 'funny guy' type.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Besides, who in this school has a sense of humor?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ben? Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Who else is left?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hmm... Good point.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Well, there are other issues.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last couple of guys I dated... Well, things didn't exaclty work out. Colt... Spencer... Even that one date I went on with Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It never felt right.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, what are you looking for in a guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's to care about? They drive you around, they buy you gifts, and they take you on dates.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh. Wow. You've totally convinced me you don't have 'boyfriends' on the brain.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Hannah

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, fine. Maybe the idea of one doesn't completely disgust me.

nodes.text: So why not just go for it?

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: And I'm pretty happy overall.

nodes.text: That's good for you.

Sam finally arrives at the swim table and sits next to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it me, or does everyone who's dating take stupid pills?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't be ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! They have no right to do this!
Denni struggles to squirm around Colt. Chad lines up a shot on her and throws an egg perfectly...
And Colt catches it mid-air! It explodes in the palm of his hand!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And `that` is the final straw!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] is the final straw!

nodes.text: Colt bounds towards the three guys! In one quick move, he weaves under Chad's punch and smashes the crushed egg into Carson's face!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Agggh!
Carson staggers back! Chad tackles Colt around the waist, and the two tumble backwards into the sand!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Go for his eyes! Go for his eyes!
Chad pins Colt down! Colt reaches up, jams his palm under Chad's chin, and tries to push his face away...
And that's when Denni runs up, pulls a can of pepper spray out of her purse, and blasts it in Chad's face!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Aggggghhhh!
Chad recoils away! Carson helps him up, and the three guys stagger back...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This isn't over! Not by a `long` shot!
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't over! Not by a [color=#e23b3b][i]long[/i][/color] shot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you better believe it isn't over!
The three guys retreat onto the boardwalk. Denni runs over and slumps down next to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'm all right. Some egg on my shirt beats the heck out of a face full of pepper spray.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You ask me? I call that a win.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Some first date, huh?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, it wasn't some perfect romantic night with candles and flowers and all that pink stuff...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But having a crazy adventure and coming out on top, against the odds? Well, that's about as `us` as it can get.
nodes.text_bbcode: But having a crazy adventure and coming out on top, against the odds? Well, that's about as [color=#e23b3b][i]us[/i][/color] as it can get.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Denni nuzzles into Colt's arms. He gently kisses the side of her neck.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Those Spartan guys... They're not going to leave us alone, are they?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nope. Not until we totally crush them until they've got nothing left. Not until they know, once and for all, that we are `not` to be messed with.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nope. Not until we totally crush them until they've got nothing left. Not until they know, once and for all, that we are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] to be messed with.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you saying...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Yeah, I am. I'm signing up for the Spartan Games to fight by your side...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And we're gonna win this thing together!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, Colt!
Colt tries to dive in front of Denni... But slips on the sand!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!
The eggs sail clear over him and splatter against Denni, coating her in sticky, yellow yolk!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ewwww! No!
She trips and falls down on top of Colt! The three guys point and laugh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You pathetic sons of...
Colt is cut off by an egg bursting against his forehead! Yolk oozes into his eyes! He tumbles onto his back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on!
Carson, Chad and Percy empty out their cartons, and then turn to walk away...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: See you later... Losers.
They vanish onto the boardwalk. Denni pulls herself up and scrambles to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm surprised. I would've expected you to be the first to sign up for the chance to stick it to some of the Spartan guys...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got their school shut down, their secret society disbanded, and their leader deported. I'll be honest, I'm pretty sure I `already` stuck it to them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I got their school shut down, their secret society disbanded, and their leader deported. I'll be honest, I'm pretty sure I [color=#e23b3b][i]already[/i][/color] stuck it to them.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee! Come on! Tell me you're not jonesing to see them taken down another peg?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A year ago? Sure. But now? Honestly? I've got more important things to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow... The new `mature` Colt Warren. Who knew this day would ever come?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... The new [color=#3b78e2][i]mature[/i][/color] Colt Warren. Who knew this day would ever come?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mature? Please. I just don't feel like playing some spoiled rich-boy's game. I'm `done` with the Spartans.
nodes.text_bbcode: Mature? Please. I just don't feel like playing some spoiled rich-boy's game. I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]done[/i][/color] with the Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Unfortunately... We're just `beginning` with you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Unfortunately... We're just [color=#e23b3b][i]beginning[/i][/color] with you!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni spin around to find Chad, Carson and Preston standing behind them!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well, well, well. Isn't this just adorable? Beauty and the Beast on their big date.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? Come a step closer, and I'll show you just how adorable my fists can be...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ah... Now `there's` the blue-collar trash I was expecting!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah... Now [color=#e23b3b][i]there's[/i][/color] the blue-collar trash I was expecting!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: All that lovey-dovey stuff between you two was seriously making me sick...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You were following us? That is `not` okay! You had `no` right!
nodes.text_bbcode: You were following us? That is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] okay! You had [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] right!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Oh really? Well, did `you` have the right to ruin our school?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? Well, did [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] have the right to ruin our school?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes! `Yes` we did!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes[/i][/color] we did!

nodes.text: Colt stands up and cracks his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, guys, I really don't want any trouble... I'm just trying to have a nice night with my girlfriend here...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I never get tired of hearing you call me that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So do me a favor and just keep walking, okay? We don't want this to get any uglier than your faces already are.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Sure thing! No problem! We'll just get going then, right guys?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Of course!
The three guys turn to leave, when...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh! Wait! How rude of us! We couldn't leave without giving you a parting gift!
The guys spin around and reveal that they're each holding a carton of eggs!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Get `down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Denni! Get [color=#e23b3b][i]down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow, don't have `too` much confidence in me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, don't have [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] much confidence in me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry, but it's true! This is going to be a physically-grueling 3-day paintbrawl, not Indie Band Trivia!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, first of all, I don't even listen to `that` many indie bands...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, first of all, I don't even listen to [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] many indie bands...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pffft.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And second, what do you think I am, some kind of meek, wilting flower?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry, did I somehow miss your huge muscles and years of combat training? There's a reason I call you `Tiny` Hipster!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'm sorry, did I somehow miss your huge muscles and years of combat training? There's a reason I call you [color=#e23b3b][i]Tiny[/i][/color] Hipster!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, and if strength was the only thing that mattered, maybe you'd have a point... But there's more than one way to skin a cat!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're doing `what` now?
nodes.text_bbcode: We're doing [color=#e23b3b][i]what[/i][/color] now?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The point is, I can totally hold my own in something like the Spartan Games. I'm sneaky `and` crafty, and I've been taking self-defense classes for years!
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is, I can totally hold my own in something like the Spartan Games. I'm sneaky [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] crafty, and I've been taking self-defense classes for years!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Funny story... My mom was always worried about me running into the wrong kind of guy. You know, the kind that ride motorcycles and have tattoos?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now look, I'll be nice and write this off as you trying to protect me, because I really don't want to bring down our first date by having a fight...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I'm choosing to do this, and there's nothing you can do about it.
Colt shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...You really don't take any crap from anyone, do you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nope! And that's why I'm gonna win!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on, it's a school-sponsored contest. I'm `not` going to get hurt...
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, it's a school-sponsored contest. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to get hurt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a school-sponsored contest being run by the psychos from Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Do you not remember when they tried to run us off the road with a helicopter?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, that was bad, but this is different... For starters, Percy isn't involved...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, sure, Percy's gone. But the rest of those guys hate us and are out for revenge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think they won't be tempted to play dirty and go for the foul?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, listen...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, you listen. That night, when the bike spun out and you were lying there... When I thought something had happened to you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know. For that second, I felt like I'd died inside.
Denni reaches up and touches Colt's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
Colt takes her hand.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean it, Princess. The thought of you getting hurt just tears me up inside. I can't let you risk it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's sweet. It really, `really` is.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's sweet. It really, [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] is.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But this is `my` decision. And I can handle myself.
nodes.text_bbcode: But this is [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] decision. And I can handle myself.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I won't get hurt. I promise. I'll quit before it comes to that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There's no way I'm talking you out of this, am I?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not even a chance.
A wave crashes loudly against the rocks. Denni jumps.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay, Princess? You seem tense.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe a little... I think the Spartan Games have me on edge...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The Spartan Games? More like the 'big, stupid, blood-bath you'd have to be an idiot to sign up for...'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why are you worried about it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Uh... I'm signing up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What?!` What are you talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color] What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you joking? Is this some weird hipster thing where you say the opposite of the truth?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not joking, Colt, and that's not a hipster thing. Of `course` I'm signing up.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not joking, Colt, and that's not a hipster thing. Of [color=#3b78e2][i]course[/i][/color] I'm signing up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But why?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The prize is `$100,000!` Do you know how much good I could do with that? I could finally update the journalism club's equipment... Fund a bunch of W.H.A.L.E projects... Maybe even fix that broken stairway behind the cafeteria...
nodes.text_bbcode: The prize is [color=#3b78e2][i]$100,000![/i][/color] Do you know how much good I could do with that? I could finally update the journalism club's equipment... Fund a bunch of W.H.A.L.E projects... Maybe even fix that broken stairway behind the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is a `huge ` opportunity to improve Centerscore High, Colt. I can't pass it up.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge [/i][/color] opportunity to improve Centerscore High, Colt. I can't pass it up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But don't you get it? That's `exactly` what the Spartans want you to think! It's a total trap!
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't you get it? That's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what the Spartans want you to think! It's a total trap!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That might be true, but... I just can't pass up the chance, Colt. If there's even a possibility I could win...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...A fancy restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Like, for real?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dang, Princess, don't hold back! Is it that hard to believe?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you, I just... Have a hard time picturing you at a fancy restaurant, that's all...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, what, I'm too low-class for that? You think I'll spill engine grease on the table and try to skip out on the bill?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Me Colt! Me so poor! Me eat napkin instead of food!' Is that what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, of course not! And not just because the thing about the napkin is kind of weird!
Denni hugs Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll admit, a fancy restaurant isn't where I thought we'd go on our date... But if you want to take me there, I'm sure you'll do just fine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'll do `better` than fine. I'm gonna blow your mind with how fancy I can be. From now on, you might as well call me Sir Coltington the Fourth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'll do [color=#e23b3b][i]better[/i][/color] than fine. I'm gonna blow your mind with how fancy I can be. From now on, you might as well call me Sir Coltington the Fourth!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Twenty minutes later, at `The Oceanside Obelisk,` Colt and Denni are seated at a table...
nodes.text_bbcode: Twenty minutes later, at [b]The Oceanside Obelisk,[/b] Colt and Denni are seated at a table...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Good evening, sir and madame. Here are your menus...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why thank you, goodman waiter! I do most appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: ...Right.
Colt grins and holds up the menu.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See? `Fancy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: See? [color=#e23b3b][i]Fancy.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He cracks it open and reads a few items...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Um, excuse me? Waiter, sir? Might I inquire you a question, perchance?

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: ...Of course.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: These numbers, here on the right... Are they the prices?

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Yes, sir.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For real, though? This isn't like a prank menu?

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Why would we possibly give you such a thing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No reason. Just curious. Pip pip, cheerio. Be on your way!
The waiter walks off. Colt sets down the menu and looks at Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wanna just get hot dogs on the boardwalk?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, please!
Minutes later, Colt and Denni sit on the beach, eating hot dogs and staring out at the crashing waves...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry to let you down, but I really didn't feel like going into debt over a dinner out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I totally understand. I'm not really into the idea of paying $250 just to eat a plate of snails.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Snails? Seriously? Rich people are sick in the head...
Denni pats Colt's hand.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If it's any consolation, `you` did just great... Sir Coltington.
nodes.text_bbcode: If it's any consolation, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] did just great... Sir Coltington.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A burger joint?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, not just any burger joint. `The` burger joint! Chubby Chuck's Chub-burger!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, not just any burger joint. [color=#e23b3b][i]The[/i][/color] burger joint! Chubby Chuck's Chub-burger!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Chub-burger?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, so it's not exactly the best name in the world... But I'm telling you, it'll blow your mind!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...You don't seem excited.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, no, it's just... I spent so long secretly imaging what our first date would be like...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess I never thought we'd be going to a burger joint.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look here, Tiny Hipster. You know me. You know who I am.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If I want me to pretend to be someone I'm not, I can act all cheesy and take you to some French restaurant and dance around with a rose between my teeth...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or you can trust me, and let me buy you the best burger you will ever eat in your life.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Okay. But it `better` be amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Okay. But it [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] be amazing!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you have no idea.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: By the way... You do know I'm vegeterian, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup! And just for you, I scouted their tofu burger! And even `it's` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yup! And just for you, I scouted their tofu burger! And even [color=#e23b3b][i]it's[/i][/color] good!

nodes.text: An hour later, Denni and Colt sit at a nice table in a restaurant on the boardwalk...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: O...M...G... That was `amazing!`
nodes.text_bbcode: O...M...G... That was [color=#3b78e2][i]amazing![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I had `no` idea tofu could even be that good! It's like my mouth is exploding with flavor!
nodes.text_bbcode: I had [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] idea tofu could even be that good! It's like my mouth is exploding with flavor!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How do they `do` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: How do they [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My theory? It's really unicorn meat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Denni reaches across the table and squeezes Colt's hand.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This was lovely.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wanna go for a walk along the beach? That's a thing girls like, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Girls? No idea. But `I'd` love a walk on the beach.
nodes.text_bbcode: Girls? No idea. But [color=#3b78e2][i]I'd[/i][/color] love a walk on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh!
A little while later, Denni rests in Colt's arms by the waterfront...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mmm... This is nice...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah...
Late one night, Colt gently cruises on his motorcycle down a pleasant suburban street and stops in front of a modest house. Denni sits waiting on the front steps...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, hey there. What's a good girl like you doing in a bad place like this?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know. Maybe waiting for a certain bad boy to take her out on their very first date...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A bad boy, huh? Well, then you're going to have to keep waiting, Princess. I happen to be a reformed man...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Who said I was talking about you, huh? For all you know, the guy `I'm` waiting for is way more bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who said I was talking about you, huh? For all you know, the guy [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] waiting for is way more bad!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yep! He has, like, twice as many tattoos and drives `two` motorcycles!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yep! He has, like, twice as many tattoos and drives [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] motorcycles!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh! Come here, Tiny Hipster!
Denni runs over and gives Colt a little kiss.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You look nice.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You too. Now come on, let's get out of here. My mom'll kill me if she sees me on a motorcycle!
Colt revs the engine, and the two take off, gently weaving through the streets...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So. Our first `real` date.
nodes.text_bbcode: So. Our first [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] date.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know. It feels so weird, doesn't it? Doing something so... Normal?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Shouldn't we be taking down a corrupt principal or sliding under a helicopter?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Please. You think I'm the kind of guy that puts out like that on a first date?
Denni playfully pokes Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously, where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I was thinking we could start by going to a...

nodes.prompt: We could start by going to a...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We could start by going to a...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, then, I guess it's official. No one is signing up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Justin! You too?! You're the one who got us into this in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah... But then I watched some of the Spartan guys practice. They're `really` scary.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... But then I watched some of the Spartan guys practice. They're [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] scary.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Chad's muscles are as big as my head!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry, everyone. Looks like the Spartan guys are going to get the money.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe that won't be all that bad... Some of them `are` pretty cute...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe that won't be all that bad... Some of them [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] pretty cute...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What does that have to do with anything?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You wouldn't understand. Girls... Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... Not you too, Jessica! You're the one that encouraged me to get up here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I backed you because I thought you were a winner... But it's pretty clear you're a `loser.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, I backed you because I thought you were a winner... But it's pretty clear you're a [color=#3b78e2][i]loser.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I mean, if you can't even get Erik Ericson to get your back...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm very easily swayed!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, Ben. We're done.
Jessica turns around and walks out. The cheerleaders file after her, followed shortly by the rest of the school.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...What just happened?!
Wow! Who knew the students of Centerscore High were such a bunch of quitters?
That can't be right! Try again and see if you can rally some more school spirit!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great! Anyone else?
Erik stands up.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not really signed up... But whoa boy, that got my blood going! I love Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not because I like changing who I am or anything, but because I've got so many friends here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll... I'll sign up!
The girls on the swim team stand up.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We're in!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We love Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And guys who own motorcycles with four-stroke, multicylinder engines!
The girls turn to Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? I did some research over the break!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Anyway, we'll sign up!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What? Sit back down...
Jessica stands up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll sign up too!
Jessica eyes the rest of the cheerleaders. They all stand up!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're in, too! But I am `not` getting any dirt on me!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're in, too! But I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] getting any dirt on me!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Standing is my favorite activity!
Ryan stands up.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh... I'm in too. Because of, you know... Cheerleaders.
Soon, everyone from Centerscore is standing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think about your odds now, Chad?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Shut up!
Chad and the rest of the Spartans storm out of the cafeteria...
Looks like a showdown's coming!
You played a great game, helping Centerscore rally together in its time of need!
Stay tuned next week for the beginning of the Spartan Games!

Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: There is a long quiet moment...
And no one stands up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really, guys? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, dude, it's just not worth the risk. I'm hoping to get a football scholarship into college... I can't risk getting hurt over some dumb paintball contest.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, Ben, it's `way` too dangerous! I can't risk injuring these programmin' hands!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Ben, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too dangerous! I can't risk injuring these programmin' hands!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... But school pride...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, this school's okay, but it is `not` worth getting shot with paint over!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, this school's okay, but it is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] worth getting shot with paint over!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing is!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't even like `looking` at paint!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even like [color=#e23b3b][i]looking[/i][/color] at paint!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So none of you are signing up?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm not!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Me neither!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey new, hot Ben, I heard that you signed up for the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Aren't you worried?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not really... What's there to be worried about?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I heard, like, almost no students from Centerscore have signed up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah... And today's the last day for registration.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If there aren't any Centerscore students, the Spartans will pick us off one-by-one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, at least you signed up. That's something to be proud of.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...
Jessica leans in close to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have to tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A... A lot of people see me as this strong, bossy girl...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But do you remember how I was when you first came over to my place?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course. You were... Vulnerable.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was. That was... That was the real me. I don't show it often because...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because sometimes you have to be what people need you to be, not who you are.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I think right now they need you to be a leader.
Ben looks around the cafeteria. Everywhere, he sees Centerscore students, their eyes turned downward.
He stands up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, everyone, can I have your attention?
The students look up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm Ben Kale.
A ripple of murmurs runs through the students.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, I know. I look different, but trust me... I'm still the same guy who gets A's on my tests and throws Halloween masquerade balls!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Sit down, loser.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I won't! I won't because I just found out some disturbing news...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just found out that only a handful of you have signed up for the Spartan Games.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What chance do we have? They're called the `Spartan Games!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What chance do we have? They're called the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan Games![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't argue with that...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Then sit down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But what I can say is this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we don't participate in these games, there's a very real chance that the Spartan guys will run our school the same corrupted way they ran theirs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you really want to lose the spirit of Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Think about what this school has done for you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I don't know your story...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if you're a popular girl who found salvation with nerds...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if you're a bully who reformed himself to become a star linebacker...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! That sounds like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or just a nice girl who found lasting love...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I do know `my` story. I know that this is a place where a person can change.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I do know [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] story. I know that this is a place where a person can change.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where you can be a nerd and `become` popular... If that's what you want!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where you can be a nerd and [color=#e23b3b][i]become[/i][/color] popular... If that's what you want!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But how easy do you think it will be to change once Spartan's got us in the clutches of their class system?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Rise up, Centerscore! If you've already signed up, stand up! Be proud!
Ben has failed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How's it coming?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! Thanks for being so patient!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just a few more wardrobe changes... And then I'll have to work on that haircut...
The next day, at the Center Table...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, guys... What do you think of `the new Ben?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, guys... What do you think of [color=#3b78e2][i]the new Ben?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I haven't seen him all day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's right here!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ben's a ghost?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No... This is Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I look a lot different now...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Ben?!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You got hot!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Ben's a hot ghost!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. It's okay, Amanda. I'm not a ghost.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm glad you all think I look good...
Ben leans over to Jessica...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No probs!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A lot of people think I have blue eyes! But they're actually green!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just make sure you match with green... Not blue!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I got it! I got it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And mauve looks really bad on me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You realize that most guys don't know what mauve is, right?!
After several more hours of griping...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hold still! I'm trying to cut your hair!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not too short! If it's too short, my eyes end up looking all buggy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not going to cut it too short! Just keep your head still!
`Snip!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Snip![/b]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-oh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What was that? What happened?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can fix it! Don't worry so much, you're making me nervous, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm worried!
Jessica makes a few more cuts...
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hello, new kid! Would you like to be my friend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: New kid?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik! It's me! I just got a bad makeover!
Suddenly, Ryan shoves Ben in the back!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, freshman nerd! I need you to give me math answers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? I'm Ben! Remember? I sit at the Center Table, I throw epic parties, I kissed Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're talking about Ben Kale, freshman. He's a lot cooler than you.
Ryan grabs Ben by the collar and lifts him off the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're going to give me your math homework...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If you don't, I'll punch you right in your big, buggy eyes...
Ryan drops him on the floor hard!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great. Thanks a lot, Jessica...
Oh no! It looks like all of Ben's progress has been reset!
All because he didn't trust Jessica...
That night, Ben comes over to Jessica's place.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben! You okay? What's up?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I decided. I'm... I'm going to enter the Spartan Games.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you sure?!
Ben sits down on Jessica's bed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't start over, Jess. I can't be the nerd again, the one that everyone picks on because they all think I'm a... A chicken...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to be more than that, and I think these Spartan Games might be my only chance, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, Ben! I'm totes excited!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You... You are?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Duh. Of course! You want to be popular, and if you win, you'll be the most popular guy in the whole school!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hadn't even thought of that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Eek! I just had, like, the best idea ever!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you might not like it at first, but hear me out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is like the perfect time to give you a makeover!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A makeover? Isn't that kind of... Well, really girly?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It doesn't have to be!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just think if you're going to try to be popular, you should enter into the Spartan Games looking your best!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that... I'm in!
Jessica starts rummaging through her closet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You have guy clothes in your closet?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry about it!
She holds up a shirt to Ben's frame, eying how it looks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Are you qualified for this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! I know what a hot guy looks like! Just let me do this, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who cares about that kind of thing?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You mean, who cares about battling in the wilderness for school pride `and` power!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, who cares about battling in the wilderness for school pride [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] power!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... Okay, that did make it seem kind of cool.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: So, then, maybe `you're` what's lame?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, then, maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] what's lame?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ha!
Chad shoves Ben to the ground as the Spartans walk away laughing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh... Well, it did this week!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine! Then I'll sign up!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Good. We'll be looking forward to hunting you down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not if I hunt you down first!
Chad steps aggressively toward Ben, but Principal Shapiro turns the corner.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Gentlemen! It's time to get to class!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You're lucky, shrimp. We'll be looking for you at the Spartan Games!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, that `was` lucky.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] lucky.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Whoa, Chad! You smell like my cool Uncle Rod!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I know! It's awesome! Girls love it!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But it totally ruined my clothes! And these clothes were designed by a French guy with a name I can't pronounce.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: That means they're expensive...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Ohmygosh!` Chad... You smell so... Hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ohmygosh![/i][/color] Chad... You smell so... Hot!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And manly! Like a cowboy who worked in a wood shop!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I never thought I'd consider a Spartan guy to be this rugged.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! He smells like a beardy bar of soap!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Call me!
The girls walk away, smiling back at Chad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! I think Spencer and I accidentally created the perfect cologne!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That should do it! We'll put it in his locker tomorrow morning!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've got an early football practice. So, you'll have to tell me how it goes...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, if it goes well, you should be able to `smell` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if it goes well, you should be able to [color=#e23b3b][i]smell[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh.
Before class the next day, Ben watches from the other end of the hall as Chad opens up his locker...
And gets sprayed with a fine mist of the perfume!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ogggh! What the...?!
Just then, a couple of cheerleaders walk by...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, `yeah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [color=#e23b3b][i]yeah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben pours in the bottle.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And to top it off, I'll add just a dash of...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awesome!
Ben adds in a quarter of the bottle, while Spencer stirs it in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Next, I'll throw in some Eau de...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice!
Late one night, Ben and Spencer step into Ben's father's laboratory...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad saves all the essences that his company rejects.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Essences. Smells. He manufactures them, but they aren't always, you know, rosy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand. What does this have to do with anything? I thought you were gonna help me find a way to stick it to that buttface Chad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me. The answer lies in here... What did Chad do to you anyway?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, he was a big, dumb jerk who ruined the school with his dumb face and acted all dumb all the time?
Spencer slams his fist on one of the lab tables.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I should just punch in his face during the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right, calm down. Some of this stuff is expensive...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. Have you registered for the games yet?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... No... Not yet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My name's at the top of the list! You'd better hurry up before registration closes, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I will.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, what's the plan to prank Chad?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to put a spring-loaded perfume trap in his locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Perfume? We're going to make Chad smell like a girl?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Haven't you been paying attention? We're going to make a `stinky` perfume.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Haven't you been paying attention? We're going to make a [color=#e23b3b][i]stinky[/i][/color] perfume.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Help me look through these bottles for awful smells...
Ben and Spencer look through the various bottles of essence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! This one's called `Hog Sweat!` I bet it smells horrible!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Hog Sweat![/i][/color] I bet it smells horrible!

nodes.text: Spencer uncorks the bottle and holds it under his nose...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, I wouldn't...
Spencer takes a big whiff!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Yuuuuuuuck!` It smells so bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yuuuuuuuck![/i][/color] It smells so bad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just go ahead and label that one as `Stinky.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll just go ahead and label that one as [color=#e23b3b][i]Stinky.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few minutes later, after looking through all the bottles...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Looks like we've got several to choose from.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First, I'll start with a base of `Hog Sweat.`
nodes.text_bbcode: First, I'll start with a base of [color=#e23b3b][i]Hog Sweat.[/i][/color]

nodes.text_bbcode: Ben pours half the bottle of [b]Hog Sweat[/b] into a large bowl. Spencer leans away from it as he stirs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get that stuff away from me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then, I'll add some essence of...
$ZOE collects herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, I know transferring to a new school must be very hard for all of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want you to know, it doesn't have to be like this. I'm sure we can all work out a way to peacefully coexist!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We just need to start over, right?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hardly. This has been amusing, but we're Spartans. We don't compromise, we don't peacefully coexist, and we don't lose.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Now I'd recommend that the football team clear out of here.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: The cheerleaders, on the other hand, are welcome to stay!
Mark jumps off of his horse and leans closer to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd start reconsidering that boyfriend of yours. If you want to date a `real` winner, start with the polo team.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I were you, I'd start reconsidering that boyfriend of yours. If you want to date a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] winner, start with the polo team.

nodes.text: Mark drapes his arm around $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: How you doin', girl?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, time to put this guy in his place.

options.label: Not if you were the last guy on earth!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, Colt... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! I'm `not` okay! This was supposed to be our first date! This was supposed to be special and nice and all that stuff... But instead it's been a total disaster!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] okay! This was supposed to be our first date! This was supposed to be special and nice and all that stuff... But instead it's been a total disaster!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it wasn't like that! It's not `your` fault those guys were jerks! There will always be people like that...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it wasn't like that! It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] fault those guys were jerks! There will always be people like that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But it is my fault, Denni! If I hadn't joined The Immortals... If I hadn't run off to Spartan... Heck, if I hadn't crashed Tom's limo, all those years ago...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I try and try to be a better man... The man you deserve... But I can't. It's just not possible. Not here. Not with my past.
Colt gets up and starts to walk away...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, `please!` Come back!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, [color=#3b78e2][i]please![/i][/color] Come back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Sorry, Tiny Hipster. I... I gotta go.
Denni stands up after him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `No!` Don't you walk away from me! Don't you DARE!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color] Don't you walk away from me! Don't you DARE!

nodes.text: Colt glances back, struggling to find something to say...
Then turns away and walks off.
That's all for Colt and Denni...
Now let's see how Ben is doing!
Just then, Preston comes up to Chad...
Preston inspects the trap in Chad's locker. He sniffs the bottle.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: This is a complicated compound aroma. The trap itself was rigged by someone intelligent. An A-student with access to a variety of chemicals.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Like that Ben Kale guy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Ben tries to run away, but before he can, Chad sees him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Stop that science nerd!
A hand reaches out from the crowd of students and grabs Ben.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Going somewhere?
Chad storms over to Ben, flanked by Preston.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You set a trap in my locker and now you're going to pay!
Carson rolls up his sleeves.

nodes.text: Let's get this over with, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not going to fight. I can't beat three of you!

nodes.text: Perfect chicken impression, Carson!

nodes.text: I am `not` a chicken!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a chicken!

nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then how come you haven't signed up for the Spartan Games yet?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey new, hot Ben, I heard that you signed up for the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Aren't you worried?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not really... What's there to be worried about?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I heard, like, almost no students from Centerscore have signed up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah... And today's the last day for registration.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If there aren't any Centerscore students, the Spartans will pick us off one-by-one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, at least you signed up. That's something to be proud of.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...
Jessica leans in close to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have to tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A... A lot of people see me as this strong, bossy girl...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But do you remember how I was when you first came over to my place?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course. You were... Vulnerable.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was. That was... That was the real me. I don't show it often because...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because sometimes you have to be what people need you to be, not who you are.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I think right now they need you to be a leader.
Ben looks around the cafeteria. Everywhere, he sees Centerscore students, their eyes turned downward.
He stands up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, everyone, can I have your attention?
The students look up...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm Ben Kale.
A ripple of murmurs runs through the students.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, I know. I look different, but trust me... I'm still the same guy who gets A's on my tests and throws Halloween masquerade balls!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Sit down, loser.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I won't! I won't because I just found out some disturbing news...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just found out that only a handful of you have signed up for the Spartan Games.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What chance do we have? They're called the `Spartan Games!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What chance do we have? They're called the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan Games![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't argue with that...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Then sit down!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But what I can say is this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we don't participate in these games, there's a very real chance that the Spartan guys will run our school the same corrupted way they ran theirs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you really want to lose the spirit of Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Think about what this school has done for you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I don't know your story...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if you're a popular girl who found salvation with nerds...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if you're a bully who reformed himself to become a star linebacker...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! That sounds like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or just a nice girl who found lasting love...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I do know `my` story. I know that this is a place where a person can change.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I do know [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] story. I know that this is a place where a person can change.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where you can be a nerd and `become` popular... If that's what you want!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where you can be a nerd and [color=#e23b3b][i]become[/i][/color] popular... If that's what you want!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But how easy do you think it will be to change once Spartan's got us in the clutches of their class system?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Rise up, Centerscore! If you've already signed up, stand up! Be proud!
She holds up a shirt to Ben's frame, eying how it looks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Are you qualified for this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! I know what a hot guy looks like! Just let me do this, okay?!
There is a long quiet moment...
And no one stands up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really, guys? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, dude, it's just not worth the risk. I'm hoping to get a football scholarship into college... I can't risk getting hurt over some dumb paintball contest.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, Ben, it's `way` too dangerous! I can't risk injuring these programmin' hands!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Ben, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too dangerous! I can't risk injuring these programmin' hands!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... But school pride...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, this school's okay, but it is `not` worth getting shot with paint over!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, this school's okay, but it is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] worth getting shot with paint over!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing is!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't even like `looking` at paint!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even like [color=#e23b3b][i]looking[/i][/color] at paint!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So none of you are signing up?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm not!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Me neither!
Late one night, Ben and Spencer step into Ben's father's laboratory...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad saves all the essences that his company rejects.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Essences. Smells. He manufactures them, but they aren't always, you know, rosy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand. What does this have to do with anything? I thought you were gonna help me find a way to stick it to that buttface Chad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me. The answer lies in here... What did Chad do to you anyway?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, he was a big, dumb jerk who ruined the school with his dumb face and acted all dumb all the time?
Spencer slams his fist on one of the lab tables.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I should just punch in his face during the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right, calm down. Some of this stuff is expensive...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. Have you registered for the games yet?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... No... Not yet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My name's at the top of the list! You'd better hurry up before registration closes, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I will.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, what's the plan to prank Chad?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to put a spring-loaded perfume trap in his locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Perfume? We're going to make Chad smell like a girl?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Haven't you been paying attention? We're going to make a `stinky` perfume.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Haven't you been paying attention? We're going to make a [color=#e23b3b][i]stinky[/i][/color] perfume.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Help me look through these bottles for awful smells...
Ben and Spencer look through the various bottles of essence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! This one's called `Hog Sweat!` I bet it smells horrible!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Hog Sweat![/i][/color] I bet it smells horrible!

nodes.text: Spencer uncorks the bottle and holds it under his nose...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, I wouldn't...
Spencer takes a big whiff!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Yuuuuuuuck!` It smells so bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yuuuuuuuck![/i][/color] It smells so bad!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just go ahead and label that one as `Stinky.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll just go ahead and label that one as [color=#e23b3b][i]Stinky.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Looks like we've got several to choose from.
